description: Hand-authored synthetic news editions, story groups, front pages and two reader histories for a fictional Wednesday morning (Oct. 14, 2026). English and Spanish text. Not a benchmark task.

sources.description: Original fictional text authored for this package by @byshail. All outlets, people, places, teams and events are invented; no external articles were collected, translated or adapted.

transformations: Reprinted editions copy their source edition text verbatim; the alternate-history seed is the minimal seed plus examples/scenario.json with a different reading history.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, Spanish text, variation and reuse permissions.
